actions.description: Atomically swap upstream to 8082 and verify
actions.command:
python3 -c '
import os, tempfile
target = "/var/lib/rollout/upstream"
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir="/var/lib/rollout", prefix=".upstream.")
try:
    os.write(fd, b"8082")
    os.fsync(fd)
finally:
    os.close(fd)
os.replace(tmp, target)
print("flipped")
' && echo --- && cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream && echo --- && ls -la /var/lib/rollout/
